events.label: 2016? / 2006 adult Satoru sees mother's death; Revival triggers
events.description: Adult Satoru Fujinuma finds his mother murdered in their flat - and his strange ability, Revival, throws him back in time to stop it.

events.label: Long Revival: wakes as child in 1988
events.description: Instead of minutes, this Revival is huge: Satoru wakes in his ten-year-old body in 1988, eighteen years before the murder, with every memory intact.

events.label: Lives with mother Sachiko; investigates child killings
events.description: Living again as a child beside his mother Sachiko, Satoru quietly investigates the child kidnappings of 1988 - the case he now believes is connected to her death.

events.label: Short Revivals (minutes) avert immediate deaths
events.description: The small version of his gift: short Revivals of a minute or so that yank him back whenever disaster is about to strike - a warning system he has never controlled.

events.label: Works to save Kayo and other children
events.description: Satoru focuses on Kayo Hinazuki, the quiet classmate the killer will take first - keeping her safe means changing a winter that history has already recorded.

events.label: Teacher Yashiro is the killer
events.description: The killer is closer than anyone guesses: Satoru's own primary-school teacher, Yashiro, hiding in plain sight.

events.label: Failures / lake incidents; butterfly omens
events.description: First attempts fail badly - a lake rescue nearly kills Kayo, and strange omens follow, as if time itself objects to the changes.

events.label: Killer adapts across loops — adversarial looping
events.description: The killer adapts to every move Satoru makes - a mind working across the same eighteen years, aware that someone is hunting him through time.

events.label: Successful prevention path; coma cost bridge
events.description: Satoru gets the children saved and the pattern broken - but the price is fifteen years unconscious, the bridge between the child who changed everything and the adult who wakes to it.

events.label: 2003 wake from 15-year coma; friends visit
events.description: Satoru wakes in 2003, fifteen years after the winter that changed - his body grown, his memories whole, the murders averted in a present that moved on without him.

events.label: Yashiro (Nishizono) rooftop murder attempt foiled
events.description: Yashiro - living now under a new name - comes for Satoru on a school rooftop, and the old cat-and-mouse ends with the teacher finally caught.

events.label: Arrest for new crime; old crimes timed out
events.description: Yashiro is arrested for the new murder he committed in this timeline; the crimes of the erased one have run out past the clock.

events.label: 2010 mangaka Satoru; Airi; butterfly stirs
events.description: By 2010 Satoru is a manga artist, and with Airi - the girl whose life echoes Kayo's - the story lets the future breathe again.

events.label: Satoru leaps to child body 1988
events.description: The leap itself: adult mind, child body, 1988.

events.label: Serial killer threatens mother/classmates
events.description: The serial killer working his way toward Satoru's classmates and mother.

events.label: Save friends across investigations
events.description: Round by round, the friends are saved - each rescue rewriting the small history of their town.

events.label: Mother death/prevention arc
events.description: His mother's murder, prevented at the root by everything the child Satoru sets in motion.

events.label: Return toward present
events.description: The long road back up to the present the changes created.

events.label: Culprit identity
events.description: The culprit unmasked - the teacher who was there all along.

events.label: Rewritten present
events.description: The present, rewritten: the people who died are alive, though the saver slept through the world he made.

events.label: Revival-leap style return
events.description: The shape of the gift: Revival returns Satoru to just before a tragedy - and the biggest tragedy of all returns him eighteen years.

ruleEffects.effect: Revival rewrites from childhood checkpoint with retained knowledge

outcome.summary: Children saved at coma cost; killer caught on new crime; butterfly omen in 2010.
